about_the_game:
The Axolotl Cycle is a dark visual novel exploring the boundaries of the human soul, scientific ambition, and the price of immortality.

Haunted by loss and unchangeable mistakes, the protagonist is drawn into a digital nightmare where artificial minds clash with primal instincts, and reality twists into something far more sinister.

Journey through fragmented memories, biotechnology, and the depths of a mutated consciousness. Make impossible moral choices and discover what it truly means to remain human—on the edge of pain, redemption, and ruin.

Can you break the cycle… or will you become part of it?

Key Features:

• Branching narrative where every choice alters the story, characters, and your perception of truth

• Mini-games that unlock hidden layers of the world and story

• Philosophical & scientific themes: identity, consciousness, cloning, neural networks, regeneration

• Cinematic dark atmosphere: from decaying labs to digital nightmares

• Immersive soundtrack blending dream and reality

• Memorable characters, each carrying their own version of the truth — terrifying, redemptive, or heartbreakingly human

content_descriptors.notes: The game features mature themes and plot developments, mentions of sex and violence

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS or compatible
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Quad Q9000 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.1+ compatible GPU
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, SteamOS 3.0 or other modern Linux distro
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (3rd gen) or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with OpenGL 3.0+ (e.g. GTX 660 Ti or better)
  • Sound Card: Any

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (dual-core)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD Graphics (2012+)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or newer (Apple Silicon supported via Rosetta 2)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (quad-core or better)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Apple GPU (M1/M2) or AMD Radeon
